hero.eyebrow: Blue Hole Road · Dahab · South Sinai
hero.title: Between the mountains and the sea, on the quiet road north of Dahab
hero.lead: A small hotel on its own stretch of beach, with the Sinai mountains directly behind it and the Gulf of Aqaba in front. It is north of town on the road to the Blue Hole, away from the noise of the Mamsha: guests come back here to swim, eat on the beach and sleep.

sections.section: From the mountain to the water
sections.food: Breakfast, the restaurant and the beach café

rooms.intro: Nine kinds of room in two blocks around the courtyard and the pool. All are air-conditioned with a private bathroom and free Wi‑Fi. The sea-view rooms face the beach; the others look over the pool, the mountain or the garden.

double-sea-view.name: Double room, sea view
double-sea-view.short: A queen bed and a terrace on the sea
double-sea-view.desc: A queen bed, a terrace with the sea in front, a kettle, a fridge and a flat-screen TV. 23 m². The room most guests ask for.

family-sea-view.name: Family room, sea view
family-sea-view.short: A queen bed, two singles and a sofa bed, terrace on the sea
family-sea-view.desc: The largest room, 35 m²: a queen bed, two single beds and a sofa bed in two sleeping areas, with glass doors onto a terrace and the sea.

deluxe-double.name: Deluxe double room
deluxe-double.short: Two single beds, balcony over the pool
deluxe-double.desc: Two single beds, a balcony over the pool with the mountain behind, a kettle, a fridge and a flat-screen TV. 20 m². A child can share.

single.name: Single room
single.short: One bed, balcony over the pool
single.desc: One wide bed, a carved wardrobe, a kettle, a fridge and a balcony over the pool. 20 m².

triple.name: Comfort triple room
triple.short: Three single beds, on the ground floor
triple.desc: Three single beds on the ground floor, a terrace by the pool, a kettle, a fridge and a flat-screen TV. 24 m².

quadruple.name: Comfort quadruple room
quadruple.short: A double and two singles, doors onto the garden
quadruple.desc: A double bed and two single beds, with glass doors straight onto the garden courtyard and its own entrance. 30 m².

economy-double.name: Economy double room
economy-double.short: Two beds, a window on the courtyard
economy-double.desc: The simplest room, 18 m²: two beds, a wardrobe, a wide window on the courtyard garden and a bathroom with a bathtub.

family-studio.name: Family studio
family-studio.short: A double, a single and a sofa in one large room
family-studio.desc: One large room of 30 m² with a double bed, a single bed and a sitting area with a sofa, and its own entrance.

apartment.name: Apartment
apartment.short: Two bedrooms, a living room and a terrace
apartment.desc: Two separate bedrooms, one with a double bed and one with two singles, a living room and a bathroom, with its own entrance. 30 m².

sunrise.note: The beach faces east: the sun comes up out of the sea.

section.text: The whole hotel fits in the strip between the road and the sea. The mountain rises behind the road; the rooms stand in two white blocks around a courtyard and the pool; the restaurant looks over the lawn; then the beach café, the hammocks and the water.
section.alt: A cross-section from the mountain to the sea: the mountain, the road, the room blocks around the courtyard and pool, the restaurant, the beach with its shelter and hammock, the reef and the gulf.

beach.text: A private stretch of shore with a timber shelter, pallet sofas, swings and a hammock at the water. Tea comes down from the kitchen. The beach faces east, so the sun rises out of the sea in front of you, and in the evening the mountains behind turn red.

food.text: An Egyptian breakfast is served in the restaurant, at tables beside a window on the sea. The kitchen cooks Middle Eastern dishes, seafood and pizza through the day, and there is a bar. Food and tea are also served at the café on the beach.

dahab.intro: The hotel is on Blue Hole Road, about a mile north of where the town begins. South along the shore are Assalah, Eel Garden and the Mamsha; north, the road ends at the Blue Hole. Distances are straight lines from the hotel.
dahab.byAir: From Sharm El Sheikh airport: about an hour and a quarter by road. The hotel arranges a transfer for a fee; tell us your flight.
dahab.byTaxi: In Dahab: any taxi knows Blue Hole Road. From the Mamsha it is a few minutes by car.
dahab.onFootText: On foot: guests walk to the shops of Assalah along the shore.

practical.intro: What the listings say, in one place.
items: Air conditioning and a private bathroom in every room; free Wi‑Fi. The upper floor is reached by stairs.
Check-in from 12:00, check-out by 10:00. The front desk is open day and night.
Airport transfer from Sharm El Sheikh for a fee. Free parking at the hotel.
A private beach with shade, hammocks and a café. Snorkelling from the shore; diving and trips arranged at the desk.
Pets are accepted on request. Children of all ages are welcome.
